Penguins measured per island (after cleaning): Biscoe 32, Dream 13, Torgersen 6 — 51 penguins total.

Data problems found and fixed:
- 1 exact duplicate row (row 28) was removed so no penguin was double-counted; this changed Biscoe from 33 to 32.

Issues noted but not fixed (they don't affect this count question):
- species has a case/space variant (" Adelie") and a misspelling ("Chinstarp") — irrelevant since the question groups by island, not species.
- 3 negative flipper_length_mm values (e.g. -195, -219, -230) that fall outside the valid 170–235 mm range.
- One body_mass_g value of 3,500,000 g, far above the 2500–6500 g range.
- One missing sex value (left as unknown per the rules).
